# 2 Baruch Chapter 30 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** And it will come to pass after these things, when the time of the Anointed One's coming is fulfilled, that he will return in glory.

**2** Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of him will rise again. And it will come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which were preserved the number of the souls of the righteous, and they will go forth, and the multitude of souls will be seen together at one time.

**3** And the first ones who have arrived will rejoice, and the last ones will not be sorrowful.

**4** For each one of them will know that the appointed time has come.

**5** But as for the souls of the wicked — when they see all these things they will waste away entirely. For they will know that their torment has come and that their perdition has arrived.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. The resurrection scene: treasuries open, righteous rise, wicked despair. "First ones" and "last ones" (v.3) refer to those who died earlier vs. those who died later — neither has an advantage.*
